subtitle: down-to-earth 可以表示務實、腳踏實地、不矯飾、明智、切合現實、冷靜理智、謙遜，或說話平實直接。不同替代表達的核心差別，是『practicality / grounde
description: down-to-earth 可以表示務實、腳踏實地、不矯飾、明智、切合現實、冷靜理智、謙遜，或說話平實直接。不同替代表達的核心差別，是『practicality / grounded personality / lack of pretension / sound judgement / realism / calm judgement / modesty / communication style』。

words.note: 當 down-to-earth 指某人著重可行方法、實際效果，而不是空談或不切實際的想法時，practical 很自然。它是最核心的近義詞之一。
words.example: She gave practical advice that we could use immediately.
words.exampleZh: 她提供了可以立即採用的務實建議。

exercises.original: Her advice was down-to-earth and focused on what we could actually do this week.
